facts.business: Shree Renuka Sugars Limited is among India's largest integrated sugar and agri-energy companies operating across the entire sugarcane value chain from crushing and sugar refining to ethanol production, bagasse-based co-generation and branded consumer products.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: Impairment of assets including property, plant and equipment and investments in subsidiaries
Current liabilities exceed current assets by INR 21,145.01 million
Dependence on government policies for ethanol blending programme and sugar pricing
Cyclical nature of commodity-linked, policy-sensitive industry
Cash losses of INR 4,143.53 million in current year
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards except for certain transactions which were ratified by the Audit Committee after the transactions have taken place: Anamika Sugar Mills Private Limited (Wholly owned Subsidiary) - Purchase of Export sales quota INR 3.83 million, Common Sharing expenses INR 3.51 million; Gokak Sugars Limited (Subsidiary) - Purchase of Export sales quota INR 2.70 million; Wilmar Sugar India Private Limited (Affiliate Company) - Modification of the agreement for management services INR 0.65 million.
